text: **Good afternoon, everyone. The course idea is simple: you describe what you want in plain English, and AI generates the code for you. Over nine lessons, I built nine projects — starting with a simple webpage and ending with something I never thought I could create.** **In the first lesson, I learned HTML, CSS, and JavaScript by making a webpage that changes the color of paragraphs from *The Little Prince*. By Lesson 6, I had built a full social network with login, friends, and real-time chat. By Lesson 8, I had built a 3D solar system with all eight planets and a quiz system. Every project built on the last one. But the final lesson was the most important. We had to design our own project — something that brought together everything we learned. That project is what I'm going to share with you today.** --- ****My project is called Phantom Intelligence — PI for short. It's a conversational AI agent with an adaptive personality system, persistent memory, and over a dozen capabilities.** **PI has three key features. First, an adaptive personality system — I can tell it to act like a brother, a mother, or a formal assistant, and it instantly shifts its tone to match. Second, persistent memory — I told it I love chocolate, ended the session, started a new one, and it remembered. Third, feedback-driven learning — when I told it to be more formal, it adjusted immediately and never forgot.** **PI can speak multiple languages, analyze literature, write poetry, generate images, crack ciphers, search the web, check weather, manage files, and translate documents. It learns from corrections and remembers users across sessions.** **Under the hood, PI has three layers — personality, memory, and tool integration — all built on top of a language model. I tested it for accuracy, consistency, memory, and personality switching, and it performed well across all tests.** **I'm planning to add voice integration, visual processing, deeper memory, expanded personality customization, and real-time code execution.** **PI is still a work in progress, but it's already one of the most capable AI agents I've built. I'm still improving it.**
